name: TX Hospitals
description: ABOUT TX HOSPITALS, HYDERABAD TX Hospitals is a multi-super specialty healthcare group based in Hyderabad, established in 2020. With branches in Uppal, Kachiguda, and Banjara Hills, the group has quickly grown into a well-known name in private healthcare, offering modern infrastructure and a wide range of clinical services. Each TX Hospitals facility is designed to provide tertiary care through specialized departments and advanced medical equipment. The hospitals are staffed by experienced doctors, surgeons, and support teams across multiple disciplines. Medical specialties offered include cardiology, neurology, nephrology, oncology, gastroenterology, orthopedics, pulmonology, and critical care. Facilities are also available for advanced diagnostics, minimally invasive surgeries, and multi-level critical care support. The hospitals feature a multi-tiered ICU setup, including NICUs, PICUs, HDUs, and specialized units for trauma, cardiac, and neurological emergencies. Diagnostic services include MRI, CT, PET-CT, interventional radiology, and molecular testing. TX Hospitals follow recognized clinical protocols and maintain standards in infection control, sterilization, and surgical safety. All locations are equipped with essential medical and surgical infrastructure for both inpatient and outpatient care. Accreditations such as NABH and JCI reflect the hospital group’s focus on clinical governance and quality assurance. Located in various parts of Hyderabad, TX Hospitals is positioned to serve a wide patient base with access to specialized care under one roof.

name: Royal Care Super Speciality Hospital Limited
address: No 1/520, Neelambur, Sulur Taluk, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, 641062
description: ABOUT ROYAL CARE SUPER SPECIALTY HOSPITAL Royal Care Super Specialty Hospital is a multi-specialty tertiary care hospital located in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Established in 2015, the hospital has expanded into a 750-bed facility providing a broad range of advanced medical services. The hospital offers specialties such as cardiology, oncology, neurology, gastroenterology, nephrology, orthopedics, pulmonology, and organ transplantation including liver, kidney, and bone marrow procedures. It is also known for offering fertility care, critical care, minimally invasive surgeries, and advanced neurosurgical and cardiac interventions. Royal Care is equipped with 24/7 emergency services, specialized ICUs and NICUs, advanced diagnostic labs, and in-house imaging facilities like MRI, CT, and ultrasound. The hospital uses modern medical technology and has implemented infection control practices and patient safety protocols aligned with national and international standards. It is accredited by NABH (India), JCI (International), and SRC (Surgical Review Corporation), and has received recognition for endoscopy safety and antimicrobial stewardship. Inpatient options include general wards, private rooms, and deluxe suites with supportive amenities such as dietary customization, nurse call systems, and round-the-clock medical care. The hospital provides services for international patients, including help with visa documentation, interpreter support, airport transfers, and guidance for accommodation and food preferences. Royal Care emphasizes clinical excellence, evidence-based practices, and ethical medical care with a team of highly qualified doctors and specialists. Located in Coimbatore, the hospital is accessible through domestic and international travel routes and serves patients from various regions of India and abroad.

name: Be Well
description: ABOUT BE WELL HOSPITALS Be Well Hospitals is a rapidly growing chain of multispecialty secondary care hospitals headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Established in 2011 , the network was created with the vision of delivering accessible, affordable, and quality healthcare to communities that lack large tertiary care facilities. A group of “small-giant” hospitals , Be Well focuses on bringing modern medical services closer to patients through centres located in both urban and semi-urban regions across Tamil Nadu. Operates more than 12 multispecialty hospitals across locations including Chennai (Anna Nagar, T. Nagar, Kilpauk, Ambattur, Selaiyur, Poonamallee), Pondicherry, Nagercoil, Erode, Cuddalore, Tuticorin, Pudukkottai, and others. Offers a wide range of medical and surgical specialties , including general surgery, orthopaedics, cardiology, diabetology, gynaecology & obstetrics, paediatrics, ENT, urology, gastroenterology, pulmonology, dermatology, plastic surgery, and emergency care. Known for its secondary-plus care model , bridging the gap between primary clinics and large tertiary hospitals by providing advanced services such as ICU care, NICU in select centres, laparoscopy, endoscopy, and specialty medical clinics. Equipped with essential hospital infrastructure including ICUs, modular operating theatres, labour rooms, neonatal units, physiotherapy departments, emergency & trauma care, and digital diagnostic labs with imaging facilities like X-ray, ultrasound, and CT (in select centres). Promotes a multi-disciplinary approach , where specialists collaborate to ensure accurate diagnosis, efficient treatment, and continuity of care within community-level hospitals. Built on a patient-first philosophy , Be Well Hospitals emphasises ethical medical practice, transparent pricing, and patient education, creating a trustworthy and comfortable healthcare environment. Part of a larger mission to democratize quality healthcare , Be Well aims to expand its presence and serve millions through standardized, reliable, and community-focused hospital care. Recognized as one of Tamil Nadu’s fastest-growing networks of accessible multispecialty hospitals , known for dependable, patient-centric, and affordable medical services.

name: MGM HEALTHCARE
description: ABOUT MGM HEALTHCARE, CHENNAI MGM Healthcare is a large quaternary multi-specialty hospital located in Aminjikarai, Chennai. It is designed to offer high-end clinical care with modern infrastructure and a broad set of specialties, and serves both domestic and international patients. 400-bed facility offering quaternary-level care in a multispecialty environment. Provides care in a wide array of medical and surgical specialties such as cardiac sciences, neurosurgery, orthopaedics, renal sciences, obstetrics & gynaecology, ENT/head & neck, gastroenterology, pulmonology, internal medicine, emergency medicine, and more. Houses institutes focused on transplant (heart, lung, liver, multi-visceral and abdominal organ transplantation) and liver diseases & HPB (Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary) surgery. Equipped with supporting critical care infrastructure, including surgical ICUs, emergency medicine units, and advanced diagnostic labs and imaging services. Strong in women’s health services, paediatrics, and neonatology, etc., indicating comprehensive support for maternal and child care. Emphasises modern medical technology, clinical expertise, and patient safety standards. Located in a central area of Chennai (Nelson Manickam Road, Aminjikarai), making it accessible from various parts of the city. Handles large patient volumes and complex surgical interventions, including transplant and organ-based specialty surgeries.

name: Virinchi People’s Hospitals
description: ABOUT VIRINCHI HOSPITALS Virinchi Hospitals (now Virinchi People's Hospitals) is a leading super-specialty healthcare provider, established as a prominent institution in Hyderabad, Telangana. Renowned for its distinguished Centres of Excellence, the hospital has built a reputation for delivering world-class medical treatments, advanced infrastructure, and an unwavering commitment to patient well-being. As a leading super-specialty hospital in Hyderabad, it serves a high volume of patients across the region and through a dedicated international patient care program. Provides comprehensive multi-specialty and super-specialty care across numerous departments, including Cardiology, Nephrology, Neurology, Oncology (Cancer Care), Gastroenterology, Orthopedics, Transplant Care (Kidney and Liver), and Emergency services. The institution is recognized for its Centres of Excellence in specialized fields like Cardiology, Nephrology, Neurology, Oncology, Transplant Care, and Gynecology, offering protocol-driven, personalized treatment. The facility features a modern, advanced infrastructure equipped with state-of-the-art medical technology, including 3T fMRI, Cath labs, Neuro navigation systems, and dedicated critical care units (ICCU). Accredited by the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers ( NABH ) and recognized by the National Board of Examinations ( NBE ), reflecting adherence to high standards of quality and medical education. Extends its services through specialized wings like Virinchi Woman & Child Care and the Infertility Treatment Center (IVF), leveraging technology with a proprietary Health App for seamless patient management. Driven by a futuristic clinical outlook and continuous investment in advanced infrastructure, the focus remains on delivering exceptional care and the latest treatment modalities. Known for ensuring exceptional medical attention and personalized care that transcends international borders, catering to a diverse patient base.

name: K.G. Hospital
description: ABOUT K. G. HOSPITAL K. G. Hospital is a quaternary care, multi-specialty healthcare institution established in 1974 in Coimbatore. It operates with a dual focus on delivering advanced healthcare while maintaining a commitment to affordability and a charitable mission. The hospital functions as the main quaternary care hub in Coimbatore, supported by satellite centers and diagnostic facilities in locations including Ganapathy, Tirupur, and Erode. Provides comprehensive care across numerous departments, featuring specialized units in the KG Heart Centre, Neurology, Nephrology, Transplantation, and Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Key areas of specialization include the departments above, along with Robotic Surgery and Laparoscopic Surgery . Noted for the adoption of cutting-edge surgical methods, specifically Minimally Invasive Cardiac Surgery (Key Hole Heart Surgery) and Robotic Surgery . Holds dual national recognition through accreditation by the NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers) and the NABL (National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories). Has served over 8.5 million patients and is supported by a large clinical team of over 170 doctors . The institution is actively involved in medical training, offering DNB courses and running affiliated health sciences colleges. Provides alternative patient access and care options such as Tele Health and a structured Medical Tourism program.

name: HOSMAT Hospitals
description: ABOUT HOSMAT HOSPITALS Hosmat Hospitals is a multi-specialty healthcare institution and a premier center for orthopedic care, established in 1994 in Bangalore. The institution operates a significant network with three hospital branches across Bangalore, including locations in Margrath Road, Kalyan Nagar, and Sadashivanagar. It functions with a substantial capacity, featuring 500 beds and 28 operating theatres across its facilities. Hosmat is primarily known for its specialization in Orthopaedics , offering advanced procedures like joint replacements, robotic knee surgeries, fracture management, spine surgery, and sports medicine . Core Centres of Excellence include Orthopaedics, Neuroscience, Accident-Trauma , Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation, and Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery. Additional super-specialty departments cover Cardiology, Gynecology, Urology & Nephrology, Gastroenterology (GI Surgery), and General Medicine. The hospital has provided care to over 1.5 million patients globally during its three decades of operation. Technology employed includes the 3rd Generation Automated Robotic Knee Replacement System to support its surgical procedures. It operates a full-fledged 24/7 Accident & Trauma Care department, serving as a critical care hub. The hospital maintains operational excellence, reporting one of the Lowest Infection Rates in India , alongside services for international patients and home care.

name: DR Kola Epic Hospital
description: About DR kola Epic Hospital: Epic International Hospital , branded as Dr. Kola Epic, is a specialized super-specialty healthcare institution located in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad . The hospital centers its practice around advanced, patient-focused treatments, with a major emphasis on Interventional Radiology . Core medical and surgical specialties include Interventional Radiology, Interventional Cardiology, Endocrinology, General Surgery, Urology, and Hair & Skin Care . It focuses on providing advanced solutions such as scarless, painless, day-care treatments guided by imaging, and specialized laser-based vein closure . The facility is equipped with advanced diagnostic and interventional equipment, as well as state-of-the-art medical technology. The clinical team consists of highly qualified multidisciplinary specialists , including doctors who are internationally trained. The hospital maintains a commitment to accessible, ethical, and affordable care , with transparent pricing structures. It operates a full-service 24/7 Emergency & Critical Care Support department to manage urgent medical situations. A dedicated International Patient Care service provides assistance with visa guidance, travel arrangements, language support, and remote follow-up consultations. The institution is also actively engaged in medical advancements, incorporating research and innovation, and providing programs for education and training .
